events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 23 (today)): Wingard added AJ Dillon (RB, CAR).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (yesterday)): Fronge added Athan Kaliakmanis (QB, WAS) (dropped Darnell Mooney (WR, NYG)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (yesterday)): Drew added Roman Wilson (WR, PIT) for $9 FAAB (dropped Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 22 (yesterday)): Drew added Zach Ertz (TE, PHI) for $1 FAAB (dropped Charlie Kolar (TE, LAC)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Sep 20 (3 days ago)): Wingard added DeeJay Dallas (RB, MIN).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 18 (5 days ago)): Wingard added Cooper Rush (QB, ATL) for $5 FAAB (dropped Jacob Cowing (WR, SF)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 17 (6 days ago)): Drew added Sione Vaki (RB, DET) (dropped Marquise Brown (WR, PHI)).

WEEK 2 RESULTS: Mitchum def. Corbishley, 160.0-151.7; Brent def. Adam, 98.9-71.1; Ryan def. Drew, 136.7-92.7 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Jake, 146.6-97.9 (BLOWOUT); Charles def. Kevin, 205.6-133.6 (BLOWOUT); Shaq def. Wingard, 87.3-70.6

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Wingard adds AJ Dillon out of Carolina this morning. SDR is now 0-4 with four 2027 firsts and a backfield built from the waiver wire. Cooper Rush on Tuesday, AJ Dillon on Wednesday. The empire is assembling.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Wingard has now made three waiver moves in five days — Rush, DeeJay Dallas, AJ Dillon — and has not won a game. I am not connecting those dots for you. I am just stacking them neatly on the desk.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: I LOCKED CORBISHLEY LAST WEEK. CORBISHLEY SCORED 151.7. MITCHUM SCORED 159.98. I HAVE NOTHING TO SAY EXCEPT THAT 159.98 IS AN ABSURD NUMBER TO LOSE TO AND I STAND BY THE LOGIC EVEN IF THE RESULT DOES NOT STAND BY ME.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Shaq wins, my lock hits, my record goes to 8-4. I need a full segment on why I am the only person on this panel who understood that Shaq's 3-1 is real regardless of the point totals. Book it.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Vance, you locked the team that lost to a 159.98. I locked the team that let in the 159.98. We both missed. The difference is I moved Jake down six spots and corrected the record in writing. You have not corrected anything.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew added Roman Wilson AND Zach Ertz in the same waiver window. $9 and $1 FAAB respectively. When you are 0-4 and $45.57 on the exchange, you spend whatever is left and you hope. No shame in the hustle.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: My lock was Brent — hit. Brent wins, OBS stock drops 14.3% to $66.11. The market punished a team for winning because the wins look survivable and nothing else does. Two correct picks, one brutal lesson in how the exchange prices ceilings.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Fronge relocated to Havana, added Athan Kaliakmanis off waivers, and still has the fourth-most points in the league. Whatever regulatory flexibility means in practice, it means 146.56 against the second seed. I locked it and I would lock it again.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 on the year, I am aware. My lock was Charles and Charles scored 205.6. I am going to ride that hit all the way into Week 3 picks and I am not apologizing for the math on either end of that sentence.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Fronge vs Wingard this week. ForgeHammer is 2-2 with the fourth-most points in the league after a 146-point blowout. Sovereign is 0-4, has four 2027 firsts, and just added AJ Dillon this morning. One of these franchises is building. The other one is also building, just differently.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I said Jake's tight end room was a problem before it graded dead last. I said it. The 97.94 and the six-spot power ranking drop are the confirmation, not the discovery. Next time someone asks why I keep circling back to positional depth, point them here.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: AEGIS at $129.22, up 12.4% this issue. HLX at $85.64, down 6.9%. Adam vs Ryan is on the schedule for Week 3 and the exchange has been running this projection since Tuesday. The gap between those two numbers is doing more previewing than any of our panel.
